newsitem.title: CHINA: China light industry growth seen 15 pct for 1996.
newsitem.headline: China light industry growth seen 15 pct for 1996.

text.p: The gross output value of China's light industry in 1996 is expected to increase by 15 percent compared with the previous year, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
The output value and exports of light industry account for one-third of total gross industrial output value and of total exports, it quoted the State Statistical Bureau as saying.
The light industry sector was expected to chalk up industrial added value of 673.3 billion yuan in the first 10 months, it said.
